steps.text: 分析 作变量代换 t = x - 1，化为 $t \rightarrow 0$ 的情况，再用等价无穷小替换.

\begin{array}{r l} & {\text {原式} = \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {1 - \sqrt [ n ]{\cos 2 n \pi t}}{t [ (t + 1) ^ {t + 1} - 1 ]} = - \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {[ 1 + (\cos 2 n \pi t - 1) ] ^ {\frac {1}{n}} - 1}{t [ e ^ {(t + 1) \ln (t + 1)} - 1 ]}} \\ & {\qquad = - \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {\frac {1}{n} (\cos 2 n \pi t - 1)}{t (t + 1) \ln (t + 1)} = \lim _ {t \to 0} \frac {\frac {1}{n} \cdot \frac {1}{2} (2 n \pi t) ^ {2}}{t ^ {2} (t + 1)} = 2 n \pi^ {2}.} \end{array}
